exposure: physical fitness during early second trimester
outcome: Umbilical arterial and venous partial pressure of carbon dioxide and oxygen
cohort: 159 pregnant women participating in the GESTAFIT Project
finding: Increased physical fitness during pregnancy was associated with better neonatal outcomes and a decreased risk of cesarean section.
mod_finding: Women who had cesarean sections had lower cardiorespiratory fitness at 16 weeks and worse overall physical fitness at 16 and 34 weeks gestation compared to those who had vaginal births.
